text:
ella: Heads up — Sentinel alerted on EU inference cluster after the canary rollout. 95th latency ~2x baseline, queue depth spiked on redis-proxy. I'm putting the active release window on hold.

deploy-bot: Release slot 2026-03-20T02:30Z paused by ella. Canary traffic isolated to s-eu-01. Attempts to route to fallback completed.

mike: thanks. Do we have visibility if this is model-related (KV cache churn) vs infra (redis/worker saturation)?

oncall-sre: initial traces show increased tail latency at inference-worker, GC not the culprit. KV cache eviction rate jumped ~15% at the same time as the canary. Could be model sequence-length distribution change causing larger KV writes.

shreya: if it's KV/cache related then rolling back the model version might not help long-term. But for safety we should pin canary to previous model for a short fallback window and then investigate. Also we should update release notes and customer-facing status. :loudspeaker:

release-manager: Proposal: 1) Pause all non-critical deploys for next 3 hours. 2) Canary swap: pin canary to v1.2.3-stable for 60m fallback, keep v1.2.4-rc running in isolated slot for deeper replay tests. 3) Reschedule full rollout to 03:00 UTC (staggered across zones). 4) Post short release note + incident note to #announcements and on the release board. Agree?

mike: +1 to the plan. Also suggest running targeted replay of failing traffic against v1.2.4-rc in a canary replay environment. We should capture KV key sizes and frequency.

oncall-sre: I'll run the replay now against a dev replica and collect kv eviction histograms. If evictions are the cause we need to increase kvcache budget or change cache key sharding.

ella: sounds good. If the replay shows model behavior (longer prefixes blowing up cache) we can look at heuristic prompt truncation as a quick mitigation.

release-manager: Executing actions now. Steps:
```
# commands to execute
deploy-bot pause-slot 2026-03-20T02:30Z --by ella
deploy-bot pin-canary -slot s-eu-01 --version v1.2.3-stable --duration 60m
deploy-bot schedule-rollout --time 2026-03-20T03:00Z --stagger 10m
```

deploy-bot: Commands accepted. Pinning canary to v1.2.3-stable on s-eu-01 (expires 2026-03-20T03:30Z). Full rollout rescheduled to 2026-03-20T03:00Z with 10m zone stagger. Non-critical deploys blocked until 2026-03-20T05:30Z.

shreya: I'll draft a short release note + incident blurb. Suggest wording: "Canary in EU paused due to elevated inference latency; rollback guard applied; full rollout rescheduled. Teams are investigating cache evictions." I'll post to #announcements and the release doc.

oncall-sre: Replay results: kv eviction rate reproduced in dev: key size spike from large system prompts. Next steps: add prompt-length histogram to canary telemetry and consider kvcache budget bump.

mike: If prompt-length histogram confirms, we should also update the evaluator tests to include a prompt that trips the longer sequence path. Add as a blocker for re-enable.

ella: Decision: no global rollback. Canary pinned to v1.2.3-stable for safety, we reschedule rollout to 03:00 UTC, run replay & telemetry, and aim to re-evaluate at 02:50 UTC. Release notes and status updates go out now.

release-manager: I'll update the release board and send the announcement. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

ella: Closing thread — will re-open if the telemetry changes.
